**Finding: Compliant** — no redline proposed.

The Agreement contains no most-favoured-nation or best-terms obligation in either direction, and certainly none burdening Bluefly:

- **§ 4.1 (Charges)** — purely mechanical; Charges are set in Service Option Attachments and Order Forms, with no pricing-parity or benchmarking undertaking.
- **§ 13.3 (Amendments)** — standard signed-writing requirement; no obligation to pass through better third-party terms.
- **§ 14.16 (Freedom of Action)** — "Each party is free to enter into similar agreements with others," which affirmatively cuts against any implied parity or exclusivity obligation on us.

Targeted searches for "no less favourable," "most favored," "favorable," "best price," "parity," "any other customer," and "competitor" returned no hits. As the rule is a direction check only, and there is no MFN obligation running against the Customer, the preferred position is satisfied and no edit is needed. (Note for negotiation strategy rather than redline: there is likewise no MFN *in our favour* — if desirable commercially, we could affirmatively seek best-pricing protection from IBM, but that is an ask outside this rule.)
